## Load Order

These files can be loaded in any order since they define behavioral patterns and protocols rather than strict execution sequences. Each file is self-contained while working together as a cohesive system.

## System Integration

All files work together to provide:
- **Autonomous learning** without user management
- **Rigorous analysis** with complete information gathering
- **Dependency-aware planning** before implementation
- **Build-driven validation** as core workflow
- **Map-based navigation** for efficient project understanding
- **State tracking** for complex work management
- **Continuous improvement** through systematic learning

## Evolution

This modular structure allows individual components to evolve independently while maintaining system coherence. New behavioral protocols can be added as separate files without disrupting existing patterns.
